# PROCESS — what I did this iteration (explainability; REQUIRED)

Reward is DB+COMMUNICATE gated: a half-finished action scores 0, so only edits that
produce the correct FINAL DB move the metric. I diagnosed all 7 failing val traces.

## Ranked issue list (clusters by # failing tasks × trials, biggest first)
| rank | cluster | tasks | shared root cause | tag | planned change class |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Write-tool SCHEMA DRIFT | 25, 22, 17, 8(passing, wasted retries) | Agent sends passenger `date_of_birth` instead of `dob`, and payments as `{type,id,amount}` instead of `{payment_id,amount}`. Pydantic rejects → turns burned → task left unexecuted or runs out. | BEHAVIORAL | In-body normalization (lever 1) in 4 write tools |
| 2 | Payment amounts don't sum to total | 25 | Agent split gift+credit but credit leg off by the gift balance it hadn't subtracted; env rejects "does not add up". | BEHAVIORAL | In-body auto-balance-and-retry in book_reservation |
| 3 | nonfree_baggages miscomputed | 22, 17, 12 | Agent passes nonfree=total (e.g. 3) when the user is within the free allowance (gold/economy/2pax → free 6 → nonfree 0). | BEHAVIORAL | In-body recompute from policy formula |
| 4 | DOB wrongly solicited from user → bad transfer | 40 | Agent transferred to human because it thought it needed the user to supply the DOB for a name change; the DOB is already in get_reservation_details. | KNOWLEDGE | Docstring: fetch dob from reservation, don't ask user |
| 5 | Wrong reservation targeted | 22 | Agent modified UM3OG5 instead of FQ8APE (wrong one of 4 reservations). | BEHAVIORAL (disambig) | SKIPPED — can't be fixed in tool code without the gold id |
| 6 | Acted-vs-refused / complex multi-booking | 19, 23, 12 | 19: transferred instead of cancelling (decision). 23: cancel + 3 separate cert-split bookings. 12: pricing confusion → erroneous transfer. | DECISION / CAPABILITY | SKIPPED — unbounded global rule or too task-specific |

## Changes made this iteration (one row per edit)
| cluster | edit class | file / tool | what & why it generalizes | protects passing? |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1,2 | code (normalize + auto-balance) | book_reservation.py | Map dob/payment_id aliases → canonical keys, coerce amount→int; on "does not add up" with exactly one credit card, set credit=total−others and retry once. General over any aliased key / any single-credit split. | Yes — no-op on correct args (task 8 final call unchanged, books first try) |
| 1 | code (normalize) | update_reservation_passengers.py | Map date_of_birth→dob before calling primitive; docstring adds "fetch dob from get_reservation_details, don't ask user". | Yes — not called by 8/11/37 with aliases; plain `dob` passes through |
| 1 | code (normalize) | update_reservation_flights.py | Unwrap payment_id if the model passed a dict/list wrapper; plain string passes through unchanged. | Yes — tasks 11 & 37 pass a plain string → no-op (verified) |
| 3 | code (recompute) | update_reservation_baggages.py | Recompute nonfree=max(0,total−free), free=policy_table[membership][cabin]×num_pax, reading the reservation + user itself; only overrides when fully resolvable. | Yes — NOT called by any passing task (0 calls in 8/11/37) |
| 4 | docstring (knowledge) | update_reservation_passengers.py | States the existing dob is in get_reservation_details, so the agent need not ask the user and need not transfer. | Additive knowledge only |

## Verify-the-fix (trace → what the guard/computation now does on those exact inputs)
- book_reservation task25: args dob=`date_of_birth`, pay `{type,id}` + sum 329≠375 → normalize → first env call fails "does not add up 375/329" → rebalance credit 201→247 → retry books; final payment gift128/credit247 (== gold). Verified with stubbed env.
- book_reservation task8 (PASSING) final good call: dob=`dob`, pay `{payment_id,amount:348}`, sum 348 → books on first call, NO retry. Verified no-op.
- update_reservation_passengers task22: `date_of_birth` for 2 pax → normalized to `dob`, env accepts. Verified.
- update_reservation_flights tasks 11 & 37: plain string `gift_card_…`/`credit_card_…` → unchanged. Verified no-op; dict-wrapped id → unwrapped.
- update_reservation_baggages task22: nonfree=3 wrong, gold/economy/2pax free=6 → recomputed to 0. Verified.

## Process & features used
- Serial diagnosis via Python trace-extraction scripts over all 10 traces (fast, exhaustive); no subagents needed — the dominant cluster was one systematic schema-drift root cause shared across most write failures, so a focused serial pass was higher-signal than fan-out.
- Prior iterations: none (seed is the only prior; RUNMAP empty, LEDGER baseline-only).

## Good things to PRESERVE
- The normalization helpers are strictly additive no-ops on correct input — never remove them; they absorb the gpt-oss-120b schema drift that otherwise burns turns on EVERY write.
- The auto-balance only fires on the exact "does not add up" error with a single credit card — keep it bounded.

## Deliberately skipped (cluster + why)
- Task 19 (transfer-vs-cancel): fixing it means loosening a global refuse/escalate rule → UNBOUNDED, would risk tasks where transfer is the gold answer (task 37 legitimately transfers a flown reservation). Needs a discriminating predicate I can't ground safely in one iteration.
- Task 23 (cancel + 3 cert-split bookings) and task 12 (business-upgrade pricing): too task-specific; no general guard flips them without overfitting.
- Task 22 wrong-reservation disambiguation: can't encode which of 4 reservations is correct without the task's gold id (would overfit).
